name: memhub-internal
description: Internal MemHub builds for XTrace developers iterating on the service. Not for public consumers — see .claude-plugin/marketplace.json for the published plugins.

plugins.name: memhub-staging
plugins.description: STAGING build of the MemHub plugin — pointed at api.staging.memhub.xtrace.ai. For XTrace developers only; installs from your local clone, so it reflects whatever branch you have checked out (use `staging`). A path source is required here, not git-subdir: this plugin's skills/hooks/scripts are symlinks into ../memhub/, and a git-subdir fetch pulls only its own subdirectory, leaving them dangling. Registers an MCP server named `memhub`, so it collides with the public `memhub` plugin: install one or the other, never both.
